% test-chapneg with hyperref, whose anchors a link leads to, and with
% the starred \titlespacing*, which keeps the paragraph after the heading
% indented. The first chapter comes after a title block.
\documentclass{book}
\usepackage{titlesec,makeidx,hyperref}
\makeindex
\titleformat{\chapter}[display]{\normalfont\huge\bfseries}
    {\chaptertitlename\ \thechapter}{20pt}{\Huge}
\titlespacing*{\chapter}{0pt}{-30pt}{20pt}
\title{A Title}\author{An Author}\date{1 May 2001}
\begin{document}
\maketitle
